annotation.bound_parties_text: The Order binds persons who have charge of the operation of small unmanned aircraft (drones), registered owners, and persons operating rockets within the State.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person who has charge of the operation of a small unmanned aircraft shall not permit that aircraft to be operated:
annotation.dates_quote: This Order shall come into operation on the 21st day of December 2015.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Irish Aviation Authority (Small Unmanned Aircraft (Drones) and Rockets) Order, 2015.
